reasoning: Hantavirus diseases are rare and no vaccine has ever reached FDA approval. With only about two years until market close and no Phase 3 trials in progress, the probability of full FDA approval by end 2026 is extremely low, around 0.5%, far below the market's 8.5%.
evidence_points: No hantavirus vaccine has ever been approved by the FDA.
There are no Phase 3 clinical trials for hantavirus vaccines that could plausibly lead to full approval by 2026.
The only licensed vaccine (Hantavax) is used in South Korea and has not been submitted for FDA approval.
Low disease incidence in the U.S. reduces commercial incentive and makes large efficacy trials very difficult.
sources_consulted: FDA Vaccines Licensed for Use in the United States
PubMed literature on hantavirus vaccine development
